lines.text: This coat costs an arm and a leg.

data.define: Used when something costs a huge amount of money.

example.text: This coat costs an arm and a leg.

misuse.text: Don't take 'an arm and a leg' literally at the store.

data.l1_hook: Lihat harga mantel ini! Itu 'arm and a leg'.
data.l1_ex: Mantel ini harganya "arm and a leg".

native.tip: “arm and a leg” = mahal sekali; harganya selangit. Contoh: “This coat costs an arm and a leg.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “arm and a leg”?
“arm and a leg” = mahal sekali; harganya selangit.
Contoh: “This coat costs an arm and a leg.” (Mantel ini harganya "arm and a leg".)
